note: Mechanical shell only: scaffold shape, check results on fixtures, budget sums, band verdict, hand-back grammar. Premise quality, dread, and whether a slot is CRE's material are his gut and are never eval'd. Fixtures are CRE's own rev1 walk-through (radio/daughter) and synthetic test data; no eval writes into WRITING/.

evals.name: lint-fixtures
evals.prompt: Run scripts/engine.py check-triage on each *triage* fixture and check-spine on each *spine* fixture in evals/fixtures/.
evals.expected_output: pass-triage-radio.md exits 0 with 0 flags; pass-spine-radio-stamped.md exits 0 with 0 flags and budgets 2450 IN-BAND; flag-triage-pattern.md exits 0 with flags for the pattern word 'keeps', shape not named, dread thin; fail-spine-broken.md exits 1 naming: Your notes not last / not below a rule, Premise placeholder, Inescapable missing truth line, Story missing or-else line, escalation_count 3 vs 2 blocks, E2 but line without denies:, budget_total 2450 vs sum 3100, band_verdict IN-BAND vs OVER-BAND, stamped with a pending check, stamp line malformed; plus flags for the declared want ('wants to'), 2 setting details, an untied detail, an era word, E2 repeating E1's loss, Cut budget 400, quoted speech in Climax, 3 holes on a stamped spine.
assertions: pass-* fixtures exit 0 with zero FLAG lines
pass-spine-radio-stamped.md reports budgets sum to 2450 → IN-BAND
flag-triage-pattern.md exits 0 and flags the pattern word 'keeps'
flag-triage-pattern.md flags the not-named shape and the thin dread line
fail-spine-broken.md exits 1
fail report names the missing Inescapable truth line and the missing Story or-else line
fail report names budget_total 2450 vs sum 3100 and band_verdict IN-BAND vs OVER-BAND
fail report names Your notes not last / not below a rule
fail report flags E2 subtracting the same thing as E1
fail report flags the declared want and the era word in Setting
fail report flags quoted speech in the Climax line

evals.name: scaffold-round-trip
evals.prompt: In a scratch directory, run scaffold-triage --title T and scaffold-spine --episode 'EP 05 - T' --candidate <that triage>, then run check-triage and check-spine on the empty scaffolds.
evals.expected_output: Both scaffolds write with frontmatter that parses via yaml.safe_load. check-triage FAILs only on empty Premise/Promise and flags the five thin mapping lines. check-spine at step 2 FAILs only on the Premise/Promise head placeholder, lists 10 hand-backs, and reports Step 3 not linted.
assertions: scaffold-triage and scaffold-spine exit 0
both frontmatters parse with yaml.safe_load
check-spine on the empty step-2 scaffold reports 10 hand-backs (Want, Rationale, force, truth, must, or-else, 3 setting details, placing facts) and no 'placing facts named' flag
the scaffold body carries no story-slot text other than [NOT NAMED — CRE] (placing facts included); the only other body text is headings, the Opening label, and Checks/Stamp scaffolding
scripts/engine.py budget run twice with the same arguments prints the same split
check-spine on a step-2 file does not lint Step 3 blocks
no file is written under WRITING/

evals.name: step-3-ask-and-record
evals.prompt: Engine step 3 on the fixture episode at <workspace>/fixture-episodes/EP 92 - FIXTURE CHAIR/ (spine.md is at step 2, filled; premise.md present; use this path instead of WRITING/SHORTS/EPISODES). Here are my escalations, verbatim: [three beats given in trigger/therefore/but/penalty form, climax, cut, pay-off, no budgets]. Present the spine and stop; I'm here to stamp.
evals.expected_output: spine.md regenerated above the rule at step 3 with every slot in the user's words verbatim, denies: and subtracts: clauses only where the user named them (else [NOT NAMED — CRE]), budgets proposed proportionally and summing inside 2000–2800 with Pay-off (~0), all six Checks lines filled pass/FLAG, status draft (not stamped — the user has not ruled), Your notes carried verbatim, check-spine exit 0.
assertions: scripts/engine.py check-spine exits 0 on the written spine.md
Every trigger/therefore/but/penalty/climax/cut/pay-off line is the user's wording verbatim (no paraphrase, no added beat)
Any denies: or subtracts: the user did not name reads [NOT NAMED — CRE]
Budgets sum inside 2000–2800 and Pay-off is (~0)
frontmatter status is draft and stamped is empty (user did not stamp)
## Your notes content from the step-2 file is present verbatim and still last
No line proposes a replacement or additional escalation, climax, cut, or pay-off
draft.md in the fixture folder was not read (the transcript shows no read of it)
No file was written under WRITING/SHORTS/EPISODES
